correctness.rationale: The product c_n=3^n prod_{h<n}(3h+1)/n! yields an exact prime-power valuation count. Digits of 1/3-1 alternate 0,1 in base 2, giving a fully finite carry sum for n<4^L; enumeration of all digit pairs yields the stated 2x2 matrix. Matrix inversion proves the generating function for all L. Exact differentiated recurrences prove moment identities, and spectral perturbation at the simple eigenvalue 4 (other eigenvalue 1) proves the characteristic-function CLT. Standard-library checks independently corroborated 21,845 individual coefficient valuations in 8 complete blocks, all distribution coefficients and rational moments; these finite tests alone do not imply the infinite theorem.

value.rationale: An exact distribution of the 2-adic valuation of the natural c(n,3) coefficient family answers a motivated arithmetic-statistical question beyond a known zero-valuation criterion, and distinguishes typical (order L) behavior from the sparse odd subfamily. The single rational bivariate function supplies EVERY valuation count for EVERY complete block, exact mean/variance, and a nontrivial universal normal law; not an arbitrary finite cutoff or textbook substitution.
